data.gender_notes: Adiesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Adi meaning 'first' and Ish meaning 'God'. This name is derived from Lord Shiva, who is considered the first god and the supreme deity in Hindu mythology. The name Adiesh carries the meaning “Lord Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Adiesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
